alerts.title: Paradise Road Status: Gate closed at Longmire: projected to open tomorrow
alerts.description: 11/05/2026: The road is open to Longmire. All vehicles, including 4WD and AWD, must carry tire chains and be ready to use them. The gate at Longmire to Paradise is closed for the night to support public safety and is projected to open, conditions permitting, tomorrow, Thursday, 11/06/2026 at 9:00 AM

alerts.title: WILDFIRE CLOSURES: Sunrise & northern trails.
alerts.description: Due to several active fires on the north side of the park, the following closures are in effect until further notice: Grand Park area & trails, Northern Loop Trail, Wonderland Trail from Carbon River Suspension Bridge to Frozen Lake, & associated backcountry campgrounds. White River & Sunrise Roads have closed for the winter season.

alerts.title: SR 165 Carbon River/Fairfax Bridge is closed: no access to Carbon River or Mowich Lake.
alerts.description: There is NO public access to Carbon River & Mowich Lake from SR 165. The bridge is closed to pedestrians, bicycles and vehicles and there is no alternate route.

alerts.title: All vehicles are required to carry tire chains.
alerts.description: All vehicles, including AWD & 4WD, are required to carry tire chains when traveling in the park during the winter season (November 1 - May 1). Choose the "more" link for tire chain requirement FAQs.

alerts.title: Winter Season Closures
alerts.description: The following regular winter season road closures are in place: Paradise Valley, Ricksecker Point, Stevens Canyon, White River, & Sunrise Roads. Closed roads may be open to bicycling when work is not underway on the road. Always check signs on closed road gates before proceeding.

alerts.title: Ohanapecosh Campground area closed for construction in 2026.
alerts.description: The entire Ohanapecosh Campground area is CLOSED for the duration of the construction project, including all campsites, visitor center, restrooms, picnic area, & Ohanapecosh river access.

alerts.title: Be cautious around park rivers & learn how to cross safely!
alerts.description: Many hikers underestimate the power of moving water. Regardless of your knowledge, skills, and experience use these pointers in making wise decisions before attempting to cross a river.

alerts.title: Your GPS May Be Wrong
alerts.description: There are five entrances to the park. GPS may take you to the wrong entrance or attempt to follow the most direct route, which could lead to closed gates. It can take hours to reroute to the correct entrance. Check directions & maps, not just your GPS.

alerts.title: Expect long lines at entrances on weekends.
alerts.description: Lengthy delays are likely at the southwest park entrance on SR706 on weekends. Check Google Maps for backup (represented by the orange/red line) at link below. Please do not block driveways or roads while in line outside the park.
